description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryService class within the OrangeHRM project's Corporate Directory plugin. It provides a service layer that manages an EmployeeDirectoryDao instance for accessing employee directory data.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryService
classes.description: Service class providing access to EmployeeDirectoryDao for employee directory operations.

methods.name: getEmployeeDirectoryDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeDirectoryDao instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.
